Discovery chose an annular_coil template for the winding section while also acknowledging conductor-shape uncertainty. A homogenized rectangular face would omit the discrete circular faces and gaps visible in Figure 8. Discovery did not emit executable geometry, so this is a risk rather than an observed wrong model.

source_coverage.figure_not_trial_output: Figure 8 is the original paper's image, not a mesh produced by any audited model.
source_coverage.material_disclosure_caveat: The selected table and FEMM figure do not explicitly tabulate conductor material/permeability. The sealed benchmark uses the nonmagnetic single-medium idealization suggested by the analytical treatment; unit relative permeability must not be called an explicitly reported FEMM material fact. Models retaining that uncertainty were not numerically wrong for doing so.
source_coverage.numerical_policy_caveat: Exterior boundary, air extent, mesh and the implementation's inductance extraction method remain disclosed numerical choices; no actual convergence or extraction-method comparison occurred.
